title: Safety infrastructure loop is live under the reliability watcher.
summary: Was: design doc only. Now: the loop runs and files its own reports.
body_md: The safety infrastructure loop from yesterday is now live. It sits under the reliability watcher and produces a signed report every run. The report goes into the loop's own history file, and any dimension below threshold triggers a rewrite pass before Pepe sees the output.
why_this_way: Design without execution is a doc. Execution without gates is chaos. This loop is both, done in that order, on purpose.
